preservedResponsibilities: Supplies the live current group/font code page to the RTF tokenizer, matching source listener ownership of Shift-JIS trailing bytes that look like control delimiters.

Routes Windows-874/1250–1258 and IBM 437/850 text bytes through pinned SAL code-page lookup and converter tables, including native undefined-byte replacement instead of browser decoder control-code mapping.
Routes RTF Symbol and Apple Roman bytes through their distinct pinned SAL converter and table owners, preserving private-use Symbol characters in the Writer text model.

Maps represented RTF group-scoped character and paragraph controls, including upper/lower/contextual spacing, sl/slmult line-spacing modes, keep/split/widow, page-before and deferred page/one-column controls with in-table suppression, absolute tab-stop positions and document default tab distance, first and subsequent section paper dimensions/margins/landscape through SwDoc page descriptors, source ConvertedN style names, first-block section references and source restart-at-one dispatch, and built-in/named stylesheet properties with run inheritance, point bookmarks, source-mapped list level numbering formats, starts and bullet glyphs, table alignment/left offset/cellx widths, row height/split and consecutive trhdr header rows with the source 10-row workaround, direct cell vertical alignment/border/padding controls, plus HYPERLINK field URL, target, name and fragment switches into canonical Writer nodes and items; listtext fallback groups are skipped.
Routes represented Apple Central European, Cyrillic, Greek and Icelandic RTF bytes through pinned SAL table owners.
Routes represented Apple Croatian, Romanian, Turkish and Ukrainian RTF bytes through pinned SAL table owners.
Routes thirteen additional IBM RTF code pages through pinned SAL byte-converter data.
RTF byte decoding selects pinned SAL ASCII, ISO-8859 and KOI8 aggregates via the shared text converter.
Decodes RTF UTF-8 code page 65001 through the native SAL converter instead of the browser decoder.
Uses OStringToOUString default conversion flags and FLUSH: undefined single bytes map to the pinned private-use range and incomplete UTF-8 is replaced.
Routes MS-932 RTF code page 932 bytes through the source-owned SAL DBCS converter, including EUDC and undefined-byte semantics.
Routes RTF code pages 936, 949 and 950 through source-owned SAL DBCS tables and EUDC semantics.
Dispatches RTF EUC-JP bytes through the source-owned ImplEUCJPToUnicode path.
Dispatches RTF ISCII Devanagari bytes through a fresh source-owned converter context.
Dispatches RTF code page 65000 bytes through the pinned SAL UTF-7 text-to-Unicode state machine.
Dispatches RTF code pages 50220/50225 through pinned SAL ISO-2022-JP/KR state machines and source-owned JIS/KS tables.
Uses the pinned SAL ImplDummyToUnicode fallback for RTF code pages without converter data, including Apple Arabic/Hebrew and unknown code pages; removes browser decoder lookup.
Maps pinned RTF underline toggles, flags and color-table values to native style, word-line and underline-color items, including direct and stylesheet inheritance.
Follows tokenizer FLAG control semantics for uld/ulw numeric parameters and leaves the registered but source-unhandled ulhair toggle without an underline item.

S3HW1E named character-style integration: stylesheet cs entries materialize actual SwCharFormat owners separately from paragraph collections, resolve same-family forward parents, and apply represented character properties. Real SwFormatCharFormat/SwTextCharFormat hints retain selected style identity, direct-property precedence and group/plain restoration; the native current character-style index remains distinct from the selected rStyle reference for failed lookups. RTF OutputTextCharFormat emits original cs IDs before repeated effective properties, as the source requires. Character-style positive baseline percentages are kept separate from paragraph automatic superscript. The represented RTFSprms getDefaultSPRM character families reset absent run bold/italic/underline/font/height/color properties present in the flattened style reference; non-defaulted strikeout/highlight/escapement/kerning inherit. Plain clears direct kerning rather than inventing a false direct override. Native style-default helper compiled unchanged with original generated OOXML IDs under ASan/UBSan yields9 defaults among35 queried tokens; scalar/nested value carriers are not full RTFValue/RTFSprms or mapper ABI. Existing run-projection/string-sink bindings remain explicit; complete native property graph, duplicate style-index semantics, linked styles, paragraph-style cs/s cross-family behavior, CJK/CTL import association, script/bidi and remaining whole-filter obligations are unverified. Temporary imported automatic style handles/sets are disposed, and export run item sets now use generator-scoped ownership.

S3HW1E native property-presence checkpoint: RTFReferenceProperties now derives from genuine SvRefBase; RTFValue.getProperties returns an actual owned ReferencePointer backed by existing tools::SvRef. Mapper nested-property consumers release only these returned pointer temporaries in finally blocks; borrowed Stream.props and existing host-owned OOXML references retain their contracts. RTF materialization uses an actual SwXTextDocument/DomainMapper and real SwPaM ranges; admitted bold, italic, font size, ASCII font, color, underline/color and kerning resource trees reach the original PropertyMap and SetPropertyValues with source insertTextPortion NOFORMATATTR, preserving explicit native item presence instead of a value-difference filter. Original raw style rPr references remain distinct from materialized SwAttrSet ancestry; flattening copies rPr children without following parents. Default style0 insertion, first-entry table insertion and numeric entry order follow source. Parent/follow controls capture currently known source names, preserving empty non-forced RTFValue query zero (WRITER206). Targeted real-owner tests cover later style edits, parent references, script scope and exceptional pointer-return cleanup. Full native parser-property state, style application through native style-table/UNO owners, non-admitted character and paragraph/table property families, replay/substreams, complete script import/export and earlier TXT/RTF/Markdown/HTML obligations remain open. Existing named-style materialization and remaining callbacks are not certified as full upstream contracts; duplicate-ID/name selection is unverified. No full native Writer/mapper ABI or whole-filter parity promotion.

S3HW1E native character-style application checkpoint: actual SwXStyle/SwXStyleFamily/SwXStyleFamilies and SwXTextDocument now admit CharacterStyles over genuine SwCharFormat and lazy document pool owners. Character property metadata excludes cursor/paragraph/frame items and preserves source MAYBEVOID/NONE flags. Character descriptor values retain native deferred validation and sorted application; attached character item vectors stage into an actual cloned item set and commit once, preserving explicit default item presence and rollback on invalid later values. Public multi-property unknown errors use actual WrappedTargetException/Any owners. Character names use original programmatic/UI aliases, default identity, collision lookup and source suffix length guard (WRITER207). RTF creation uses these real family/descriptor services, resets existing represented direct pool properties via original SetPropertiesToDefault, and keeps source raw references separate from a second owned deduplicateStyleTable result. The original source parent-name lookup and actual RTFSprms normalization precede model application. Admitted style properties pass through a real StyleSheetEntry/StyleSheetPropertyMap, actual mapper stylesheet context, stable native PropValVector and genuine Sequence<OUString>/Sequence<Any> into real UNO style setters. Existing erased sequence-address binding uses borrowed OUString views and actual by-value Any copies at the API boundary; physical layout and whole ABI are unverified. Remaining legacy strike/highlight/escapement and paragraph/table callbacks, complete native style pool/base-sheet orchestration, descriptor edge families, paragraph bulk staging, parser-wide native properties, script metadata, replay/substreams and earlier TXT/RTF/Markdown/HTML obligations remain open. Native desktop differential and whole-filter/module semantic closure are not claimed.

S3HW1E RTF strike/highlight checkpoint: original explicit SourceDocumentType now selects RTF integer highlight colors versus OOXML palette tokens, and character-style highlights follow the original mapper exclusion. RTF parser groups and emitted run snapshots own genuine RTFSprms copies for strike/dstrike/highlight; ordered independent toggle values, overwrite positions, native COW and native normalization replace the collapsed strike DTO as the materialization input. Plain clears the admitted modifier state. Actual style/run mapper vectors retain direct zero-valued items and native equal-value deduplication. Existing difference-based strike/highlight item creation was removed; escapement remains on its prior path pending a concrete position/inheritance fix. Actual group members and all queued paragraph/table snapshots release at the atomic reader lifetime boundary, including parse errors. Tests exercise valid RTF inputs, inherited/direct values and source-profile colors, rather than requiring unrelated module API completeness. Whole native parser state and unconsumed factory/UNO/module operations are not claimed complete and are not independent filter completion gates.
